questions.question_text: Which expression writes $\underset{\sim}{a}=\begin{pmatrix}-8\\3\end{pmatrix}$ as the sum of its component vectors?

options.why: Reversed the sign of each component.
Read the column vector bottom-to-top, so the components are swapped.
Swapped the components and reversed both signs.
Dropped the negative sign of the horizontal component.
Swapped the horizontal and vertical components.
Reversed both component signs.

questions.solution_text:
The top entry is the horizontal component and the bottom entry is the vertical component.
$\begin{pmatrix}-6\\13\end{pmatrix}=-6\underset{\sim}{i}+13\underset{\sim}{j}$

options.why: Dropped the negative sign of the vertical component.
Swapped the horizontal and vertical components.
Reversed both component signs.

questions.solution_text:
The horizontal component is $73$ and the vertical component is $-46$.
$\begin{pmatrix}73\\-46\end{pmatrix}=73\underset{\sim}{i}-46\underset{\sim}{j}$

options.why: Used the order of the written terms instead of placing the horizontal component first.
Dropped the negative sign of the coefficient of $\underset{\sim}{i}$.
Reversed both component signs.

questions.solution_text:
The coefficient of $\underset{\sim}{i}$ goes above the coefficient of $\underset{\sim}{j}$.
$42\underset{\sim}{j}-57\underset{\sim}{i}=\begin{pmatrix}-57\\42\end{pmatrix}$

options.why: Read the vertical step as the horizontal one, swapping the two components.
Read the lengths of the steps but ignored that both are in negative directions.
Swapped the two components and also ignored the negative directions.

questions.solution_text:
The arrow runs $5$ units left and $4$ units down.
$\underset{\sim}{v}=-5\underset{\sim}{i}-4\underset{\sim}{j}$

options.why: Swapped the horizontal and vertical components by following the written term order.
Dropped both negative signs.
Dropped the negative sign of the vertical component only.

questions.solution_text:
The horizontal component is $-91$ and the vertical component is $-28$.
$-28\underset{\sim}{j}-91\underset{\sim}{i}=\begin{pmatrix}-91\\-28\end{pmatrix}$

options.why: Swapped the components by following the written term order.
Dropped the negative sign of the horizontal component.
Took the reciprocal of each coefficient instead of copying the components.

questions.solution_text:
Read the coefficient of $\underset{\sim}{i}$ first, then the coefficient of $\underset{\sim}{j}$.
$\frac{13}{8}\underset{\sim}{j}-\frac{21}{5}\underset{\sim}{i}=\begin{pmatrix}-\frac{21}{5}\\\frac{13}{8}\end{pmatrix}$

options.why: Swapped the horizontal and vertical components.
Dropped both negative signs.
Took the reciprocal of each component instead of retaining its value.

questions.solution_text:
The top entry multiplies $\underset{\sim}{i}$ and the bottom entry multiplies $\underset{\sim}{j}$.
$\begin{pmatrix}-\frac{29}{6}\\-\frac{17}{9}\end{pmatrix}=-\frac{29}{6}\underset{\sim}{i}-\frac{17}{9}\underset{\sim}{j}$
